card.name: Deusa com o Terceiro Olho
card.summary: Pode substituir 1 Material de Fusão nomeado; todos os outros Materiais de Fusão devem ser os corretos.

textEvidence.text: Goddess with the Third Eye is a Level 4 LIGHT Fairy Effect Monster with 1200 ATK and 1000 DEF. It can replace exactly one specifically named Fusion Material Monster when used for a Fusion Summon. Every other material must exactly match its printed name. Its substitution is not an activation, has no cost, does not target and does not trigger a chain. The card may itself be in the hand or on the field as ordinary Polymerization material, including face-down field material; it may not be taken from the Graveyard with Polymerization. A face-up effect negated by Skill Drain does not substitute. Two substitutes cannot fill two different named slots, but exact printed materials remain legal. It has no other effect.
